About partial PPF

Protection where stone chips land.

Partial PPF puts clear, self-healing film on the panels that take the most stone chips and road debris on GTA highways. Mirrors covers the painted mirror caps; Partial front covers the front bumper, a partial hood, partial fenders and the mirrors; Full front extends to the full hood and full front fenders, so there is no film edge across the middle of the hood; and the Track package adds the high-impact rocker and rear-wheel areas.

We install XPEL Ultimate Plus, which carries a 10-year manufacturer warranty against yellowing, cracking and delamination. The paint is washed and decontaminated first so nothing is sealed under the film — new vehicles get a decontamination wash, and used ones a light polish so existing defects are not locked in.

Choose a package above to see a typical price range, then tell us the vehicle — we confirm the film, fitment and final price in writing before installation. Want every panel covered? See full-body PPF, or compare PPF and ceramic coating.
